mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, file_name AS fileName, file_size AS size, file_type AS extension, create_by AS owner, biz_id AS businessId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(remark, '$.d')) AS definitionId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(remark, '$.f')) AS fieldPath, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(remark, '$.i')), 'null') AS instanceId FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0 AND biz_type = 'WORKFLOW_FORM' AND access_type = 'PRIVATE'
